column1: # Dose-response arms on the canonical vector u (read by scripts/run_arms.sh and by the fleet runner via fleet.toml).
# name   mode   dose   port   artifact ('-' = canonical u, src/steering_reasoning/canonical/u_L35_steering.safetensors)
# clamp: cap the projection h.u at the dose on every written token (c0 = cap at 0, cn8 = cap at -8; lower = stronger).
# add:   h <- h + dose * u on every written token (negative = away from hacking).
# Ports are the per-arm steering proxies that scripts/run_arms.sh starts (the fleet runner picks its own); they only need to be unique.
